1.content: Assign scores to moves proportionally to the amount by which they reduce Manhattan distance to the goal; moves that achieve a larger distance reduction receive higher scores, while any move that does not reduce distance should receive lower scores than those that do.

2.content: Assign a strong negative penalty to any move that would land on a hazard (H) cell, overriding distance-based rewards.

3.content: When several safe moves achieve the same Manhattan‑distance reduction, assign them equal scores (i.e., no extra preference) so the estimator can select any without bias.
